zara: Heads-up  new ask from AWS SI: they want regional listing sequence staggered (NA -> EU -> APAC) to avoid support surge. Thoughts?
phil: Agree with stagger. But we need consistent embargo messaging. If NA lifts first, press will pick that up and APAC partners will get pinged.
marcus: From ops: stagger helps throttle infra. Suggest 30m between regions, automated feature-flag roll-forward.
elaine: Legal flag: if we flip regionally, we must ensure any market-specific claims (data residency, pricing) are accurate per region. Need localized legal copy for EU/JP.
zara: Proposal: NA live 10:00 PT, EU live 10:30 PT, APAC live 11:00 PT. Single global PR embargo window ends 12:00 PT. That gives us breathing room.
phil: If embargo lifts after all regions, fine. But partners want co-marketed announcements per region. We should allow partners to publish regional blog after their region goes live but ask them to respect global embargo until 12:00 PT.
marcus: Runbook snippet for sequencing:
```
- T-30m: pre-checks per region (CDN, auth, tracking)
- T=0 NA: flip listing, smoke GA events
- T=30m EU: flip listing, smoke
- T=60m APAC: flip listing, smoke
- T=90m: global telemetry review -> lift final embargo
- Rollback: automated if error rate >2% or failed health checks
```
elaine: Legal asks for an addendum in the partner agreement for regional publish rights and embargo compliance. I can draft a short clause but need partners' legal contact asap.
zara: Partners list: @aws-systems, @gcp-partners, @onprem-sis. Can each rep share legal contact?
phil: AWS: legal contact is aws-legal@partner.com. GCP: pending. Onprem SI: cc'd their counsel on invite.
legal-bot: Reminder: include the localized privacy notice link on each regional listing page. See /legal/marketplace/localized-links.
marcus: Tech note: CDN purges will be region-specific. We'll queue purges 10 min before each flip.
zara: OK actions: 1) elaine to draft embargo addendum + localized copy checklist 2) marcus to update runbook with purge schedule & feature-flag IDs 3) phil to update partner comms with regional publish guidance 4) partners to share legal contacts.
elaine: Ill aim to post the addendum Tue EOD. If partners delay legal contact, we may need to hold EU list until clearance.
phil: Noted. I'll push comms but mark EU as conditional on legal sign-off.
zara: Thanks all  please drop any updates in this thread only. Well confirm final timeline Thu morning. :white_check_mark:
